   269	## FAQ & Rulings
   270	
   271	These base-game clarifications are paraphrased from [Leder Games’ Rules Library](https://rules.ledergames.com/?product=root&locale=en-US&printing=p16), English p16, consulted November 5, 2026.
   272	
   273	- **Charismatic and a supply shortage:** When a legal Decree Recruit requires two warriors but only one remains in supply, place that warrior first. Then enter Turmoil because the required two were not placed. Maximum-possible placement does not fulfill an incomplete Decree action. (FAQ under 7.7 and 7.8.2; Law 1.5.4.)
   274	- **Field Hospitals during an ambush at the Keep:** Marquise may spend a matching card immediately when its warriors are removed, returning them to the Keep clearing **before** checking whether the ambush left no attacking warriors or pawns. If returned warriors remain there, battle continues. Without Hospitals, battle ends if no attackers remain after the ambush. (FAQ under 4.3.1 and 6.2.3.)
   275	- **Allied movement and Outrage:** Forcing Allied **Woodland Alliance** warriors to accompany the Vagabond into sympathy causes **no Outrage**: resolve the move as the Alliance moving its own warriors. Warriors of another Allied faction entering sympathy do trigger Outrage for that moving faction, which pays from its own hand under the normal Outrage procedure. The Vagabond pawn alone causes no warrior-entry Outrage; removing sympathy still triggers it. (FAQ under 8.2.6 and 9.2.9; Law 1.5.5, 8.2.6.)
   276	- **Coalitions and dominance order:** The Vagabond cannot form a new coalition with a player who already activated dominance, because that player has no score marker on the VP track. A legally chosen coalition partner **may activate dominance afterward** under the normal activation rules; a win by that partner also wins for the Vagabond. (FAQ under 9.2.8.)
